page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also show poor performance. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations also perform within the average range.

The instance is best suited for multi-threaded general-purpose workloads that do not depend heavily on single-core speed or local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded database operations, and moderate Redis deployments. Due to the lack of local storage and weak single-core performance, it is less suitable for high-performance single-threaded applications or large-scale LLM inference, though it handles small-model inference at average speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks reveal a contrast between weak single-core execution and average multi-core capabilities. While single-threaded compression and processing tasks perform poorly, multi-threaded workloads, memory bandwidth, and Redis operations achieve average tier results. This hardware profile is best suited for general-purpose multi-threaded applications, static web serving, and moderate database operations where dedicated CPU allocation is required but extreme single-core speed is not critical.
